Multiplies the learning rate by gamma every step_size epochs.

torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR: lr = learning_rate x gamma^floor(epoch / step_size), stepped after each completed epoch.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Training](../categories/training.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `StepLR` |
| Search words | step, scheduler, learning rate, decay |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Optimizer** | Optimizer | Yes | 1 | The training optimizer's State output; this scheduler sets its learning rate |

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Usage

```text
lr = learning_rate * gamma^floor(epoch / step_size), set after each completed epoch (torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR).
```

## Tips

- Common: decay by 0.1 every 30 epochs.
- One scheduler per optimizer; not together with the optimizer's lr_schedule.
- Resuming a run continues the schedule from the checkpoint.
